items.title: Paramount, Warner Bros. Discovery expect merger to close Oct 6
items.summary: Investing.com-- Paramount Skydance (NASDAQ:PSKY) and Warner Bros Discovery (NASDAQ:WBD) said on Wednesday they expect their merger to close on Oct. 6, bringing the two U.S. media companies closer to combining their entertainment and streaming businesses.

items.title: Paramount Settlement of Antitrust Case Approved by Judge
items.summary: The deal announced last week with 12 states, led by California, clears the way for the company’s $81-billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.title: Why Mattel Stock Is Plunging Ahead of the Holiday Season
items.summary: Mattel  stock dropped to its lowest level in nearly six years on Wednesday after the toy company announced CEO Ynon Kreiz would step down ahead of the holiday season.  Shares of  Mattel  fell 4.7% to $12.60, on pace for their lowest close since hitting $12.45 on Oct. 21, 2020, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Mattel said Kreiz will step down as chairman and CEO effective Oct. 2 to take a senior leadership position at another public company.

items.title: Ellison Picks HBO Content Chief to Run Paramount-Warner Streaming Business
items.summary: Paramount  Chief Executive  David Ellison  has picked HBO content chief Casey Bloys to oversee streaming operations once the company combines with  Warner Bros. Discovery  people familiar with the matter said.  It’s the first major executive decision by Ellison ahead of Paramount’s planned $81 billion acquisition of Warner, which owns HBO and streaming service HBO Max.

items.title: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) Stock May Have More Room Following Merger Clearance
items.summary: Warner Bros.
